reference: reference.jpg (two phone screens: Today on the left, Profile on the right)
unit: percent of the frame's width, measured from the frame's top-left corner
adaptation: Phone-only reference, unfolded by docs/dashboards/09-image-to-dashboard.md §4. Phone (375) is the twin: Today = left screen, Profile = right screen, measured in views. Tablet (820) = the two screens as two columns. Desktop (1440) = the same two columns, wider, on one molded cream tray, plus one designed region (journey). The nav is the reference's bottom bar with a raised dome on the active item at every size. Never draw phones or device frames.

frame.backdrop: the reference's backdrop, layer by layer: sage-to-charcoal gradient; a cream frosted molded tray with soft relief ridges wrapping the Today column; hanging four-point stars on thin threads below the gathering card; the dark dune sky with one bright four-point star behind the Evening column

title.note: WED · RAMADAN · 9 · crescent: thin flourished display serif, small tracked WED

dates.note: five date beads on one frosted connector band; the selected bead is dark with a saffron halo

date.note: each bead a convex glass lens

arc.note: cream frosted top with the white sun arc and a glowing cream sun; soft taupe lower band with 4:15AM and 6:08PM; bell line poured out of the lower right

water.note: bright teal liquid glass; WATER is a tab cut from the card's top-left (shapes.js tab), drop in a glass lens, 8-segment meter, 1.9 LITERS of 2.5 LITERS

gather.note: saffron-orange glass pill, thin dark bar at left, title + time, guest avatar on the right

stars.note: hanging four-point stars on thin vertical threads, the reference's ornament under the gathering card

sky.note: dark dune sky: layered sand ridges, one bright four-point star, Good evening in the flourished serif, settings gear

person.note: cream glass card overlapping the sky's lower edge; the avatar breaks out of a notch at the top-left; name, email, 8 SESSIONS | 2 JOURNEYS; Share tab cut from the bottom-left

daily.note: amber glass with inner glow; DAILY PROGRESS tab on the top-right; tree icon left; 7 thin bar gauges TH–WE

day-bar.note: thin rounded gauges with a dark fill, one per day

upgrade.note: smoked glass tray whose top edge slopes; UPGRADE YOUR EXPERIENCE › in tracked caps; flame icon

journey.note: designed region (not in the reference): This week's sessions as a vertical thread of stars and times on dark dune glass, same grammar

nav.note: the reference's bottom bar: frosted cream, Today / Progress / Sessions / Profile with icons over small tracked labels; the active item sits in a raised dome (shapes.js bump) with a teal-tinted icon

views.note: the reference's left screen, box by box
the reference's right screen, box by box
tablet: the two reference screens as two columns, journey across the bottom, the bottom bar centred

requirements.text: Desktop is a real dashboard in the reference's liquid language, not phone mockups placed on a page
Liquid glass on every card at 1440 and at 375: translucent fill, blur, light edge, coloured glow under the teal and amber cards
Poured tabs as in the reference: WATER label, Share, Daily progress title, bell line
Navigation is the reference's: Today, Progress, Sessions, Profile; each opens a working page
At 375 the Today page matches the reference's left screen and the Profile page its right screen, with a bottom tab bar fully visible
Every date bead, water step, day bar and button changes something when clicked
Three distinct layouts: desktop is a wide board, tablet is its own two-column reflow, phone is the reference's screens. Never swap one for another
Type matches the reference: thin high-contrast display serif with flourishes for RAMADAN and Good evening; small tracked caps for labels
The backdrop is the reference's, layer by layer (gradient, molded cream tray with relief, hanging stars on threads, dark dune sky), on every page and at every size
Organic shapes as in the reference: WATER and DAILY PROGRESS are tabs cut from their cards, the avatar breaks out of a notch, Upgrade has a sloped top, the active nav item sits in a raised dome
The nav is the reference's bottom bar (frosted, icon over small tracked label, raised dome on the active item) at desktop, tablet and phone. No dark side rail
At 375 the Today and Profile pages match the reference's two screens box by box (views in layout.json), including the stars under the gathering card
Progress, Sessions and Profile pages use the same backdrop, nav, glass cards and shapes as Today; no plain boxes or settings rows
